title: SpatialState
description: Canonical spatial snapshot in km with a Unix-millisecond snapshot epoch. The frame enum is currently barycentric, but this field does not identify the orientation, reference plane, or external inertial alignment of x/y/z, and some current producers do not place coordinates at a computed physical barycenter. The celestial orbital seeder uses a right-handed Cartesian transform (X cross Y = Z), with zero-inclination orbits in XY and positive inclination rotating +Y toward +Z. That mathematical convention does not prove all producer snapshots share the same physical basis; see docs/celestial-body-contract.md. Celestial reads preserve snapshots without propagation. Station market reads materialize exact-anchor host.positionKm plus the relative orbital vector in this implementation basis at host.epochMs; station epochMs equals host epochMs, not request time. They neither propagate the host nor add its parent, and do not persist read-time repairs. Unresolved station anchors fail explicitly.
